# <span id="aanchor249"></span> "Did you know?" Tips

The “Did you know?” widget displays information and tips about application features and functions. These messages will cycle automatically. To manually advance to a new message, click the “Did you know?” box.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 427;height: 249;" />

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Cycle Time">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Change Message Cycle Time</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Cycle Time">

By default, the messages in the "Did you know?" widget will cycle automatically. You can adjust the cycle frequency to be every 5 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute, or 5 minutes, or you can elect to refresh the messages manually.

<div class="procedure">

To change the cycle time for the "Did you know?" widget:

1.  Click the gear icon 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> in the top right corner of the main screen to open the Settings menu.
2.  Click **Dashboard Manager**.
3.  Click **Did you know?**.
4.  Select a cycle time from the **Message Interval** drop-down list.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 504;height: 378;" />

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Add/Remove">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Add or Remove "Did you know?" Widget</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Add/Remove">

You may elect to remove the "Did you know?" widget from your dashboard, or add it back.

<div class="procedure">

To add or remove the “Did you know?” widget:

1.  Open the Dashboard Manager and click **Did you know?**.
2.  Click the "X" icon 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" /> to remove the widget from your dashboard, or click the **Add Widget** link to add it back.

</div>

</div>
